scope.flow: StakingManager reward distribution: HYPE/kHYPE exchange ratio computed from total kHYPE supply and total HYPE, exploited by staking just before validator rewards are injected

statements.text: Before validator rewards are injected, the exchange ratio between HYPE and kHYPE is still low (e.g., total kHYPE supply 100,000 and total HYPE 20,000 giving ratio 0.2).
A user, especially a MEV bot, holds and is able to stake a large amount of HYPE (e.g., 1,000 HYPE) just before rewards are injected.
The system does not track how long funds have been staked, relying solely on snapshot values of total supply and rewards.
The attacker stakes a large amount of HYPE just before the ValidatorManager injects new rewards, while the exchange ratio is still low.
The protocol receives a validator reward (e.g., 5,000 HYPE), increasing total HYPE in the system.
The attacker withdraws or queues a withdrawal of their kHYPE position after the reward is deposited, using the updated exchange rate.

The exchange ratio is computed dynamically from the current total kHYPE supply and total HYPE, so it increases immediately when rewards are added, and staking converts HYPE to kHYPE at that ratio without any time-weighting of stake duration.

Rewards added to the protocol should not be capturable by staking immediately before the reward injection and withdrawing immediately after; a position staked only for that window should not receive a share of the newly added rewards disproportionate to its staking duration.
Reward distribution should treat staking duration as relevant so that short-term stakers do not dilute the returns of long-term and honest stakers.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether staking/withdrawal is permissionless or restricted; no unauthorized-caller condition is asserted.
The exact exchange-ratio formula is referenced but not shown in the fragments (e_9d92fff400b6_0004/0005).
Whether the attacker's withdrawal is immediate or queued is left as an alternative in e_9d92fff400b6_0007.
No explicit numeric bound on 'huge amount' of HYPE beyond the illustrative 1,000 HYPE example.
